related.note: Both explain how Lazar got the S-4 job. The story credits John Lear's help, while this telling credits a 1988 resume sent to Edward Teller, so the core claims conflict.

plain: The story goes that a pilot named John Lear helped Bob Lazar get his job at S4 in the late 1980s. Lazar is a man who says he worked on alien craft at S4, a hidden site near Area 51, the secret Air Force test base in Nevada. Lear supposedly did this on behalf of people high up in the UFO secret. An online researcher who goes by UAPGerb (UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the newer official word for UFOs) tells Michels that Lear "is on record saying in an interview" that he helped get Lazar the job. Michels has his own version from a Lear interview. In it, Lear says a Navy admiral he calls McClellan came to him. In UFO lore "MJ level" means a member of the secret elite committee said to govern the subject, and Lear says this admiral was MJ level. The admiral told him, "We got to get Bob on the job because we know that we can hide his..." Michels takes that to mean Lazar was placed so his part could be denied later. Both tellers mention a Mike McConnell or McClellan. If true, Lazar's hiring was not luck but was arranged from inside.
